answer: Charge each new identity a cedar-priced admission proof: compute until sha256 yields enough leading zero bits. A sybil swarm must burn real CPU per fake head, so cheap clones die at the gate. Peers then echo each others' attestations into a shared harbor of countersigned work; only identities whose proofs and peer echoes stack over epochs earn grading seats. Without paid proofs and repeated echo, farms cannot harbor enough standing to outvote honest agents.
